note: The second input line of the candidate is copied from the input source into heap storage; for this candidate the line contains the non-numeric token x.
The parser makes p point at the beginning of the copied input line, so p identifies the input-controlled token that will be parsed.
Parsing the token x as a number fails, selecting the error path while p still points into line.
The line buffer is freed before the error message is formatted, even though p still points into that same allocation and will be supplied to the formatter.
The error call passes p as a %s argument after the backing line allocation has already been freed, causing a read from freed heap memory during formatting.
